name: opensky Launch Secured Visa

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee is billed monthly: $24 during the first year paid as $2 per month, then $36 per year paid as $3 per month.

apr.notes: Cash advance fee $6 or 5%, whichever is greater. Late payment fee up to $41. Terms accurate as of 03/11/2026.

fx_fee.notes: 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: Secured card. A refundable security deposit equal to the credit line funds a Pledged Deposit Account.

notes: Issued by Capital Bank, N.A. Annual fee figures are the monthly installments times 12 ($2 x 12 in year one, $3 x 12 after). Data comes from the issuer-filed terms in the CFPB Credit Card Agreement Database. The Visa network package is not named, so network_tier is none. Rewards are null because the filed terms describe none and openskycc.com product pages could not be loaded (bot protection), so any rewards program is unverified.
